prior_orchestrator_verdict.rationale: All three lenses ran against the approved spec; the five ticket ACs pass, but the windowed paths bound the OTel probes to one day while Session Detail does not, so list and detail can disagree (CR-001), and two spec-required tests are missing (CR-002, CR-003). Deferred (4): span end = ts + duration not used for the session end; implausible client clock timestamps are not filtered (bounded to one day once CR-001 is fixed); reported range of a session shrinks after raw retention purges its OTel rows (dashboard windows are already clamped to raw retention); the live tests skip without a local analytics Postgres, as the existing live suite does. Dismissed 11 (other reader implementations, timestamp types, negative durations, NULL ends, leftover import, pruning/index evidence already verified with EXPLAIN, intended start-time semantics, test-style remarks).

findings.title: Sessions list and Session Detail use different activity ranges
findings.problem: _activity_cte probes log_events/spans within one day of the column bounds, get_session_detail_meta probes without a bound (bounded=False).
findings.impact: For an OTel row more than a day outside the hook/transcript range the list, Users Avg and heatmap report a different start and duration than Session Detail for the same session (AC2); the detail probes also scan every weekly partition.
findings.recommendation: Use one bounded definition everywhere; make the bound NULL-safe (coalesce to -infinity/infinity) so a session without a session_dims row still finds its OTel rows, drop the bounded flag, re-check pruning with EXPLAIN, and add a live test with a row more than a day out.

findings.title: Live test does not assert the Sessions list through the handler
findings.problem: The Sessions list is checked only through reader.get_session_cost_facts; the spec requires start_time and duration_ms through LocalAnalyticsHandler.get_sessions.
findings.impact: A handler regression in the list's start_time/duration mapping would pass the behavioral test.
findings.recommendation: Call LocalAnalyticsHandler(reader).get_sessions(...) and assert start_time is T-12s and duration_ms is 672000.

findings.title: No test that dispatch offsets are measured from the corrected start
findings.problem: The spec requires a handler test that detail dispatch bars are offset from the corrected start, so an agent launched between the corrected start and the old hook start is now placed.
findings.impact: A regression passing the hook start instead of the range start to _build_dispatches would go unnoticed.
findings.recommendation: Add a get_session_detail test whose meta started_at precedes an agent dispatch_start that is earlier than the old hook start, asserting a positive offset and a non-null duration.
